managed_step211_partial_trajectory.reading: The partial managed trajectory shows small/transient early positives but selected stable-family direction is negative by 40M, 60M, and 70M. This strengthens the conclusion that RoBERTa compact-vs-repeat is not a stable cross-encoder transfer result.

item_movement_100M.reading: Raw item movement is redistributive and does not replace official column/subtask-weighted scores; official stable composites are negative at chck_100M.

scientific_reading: Compact-trained RoBERTa learns a local source-absent relational/event denoising channel and has lower MLM loss, but selected official-compatible evidence at two separated late checkpoints is not stable-positive. This tested RoBERTa coordinate is another local-learning/downstream split, not cross-encoder transfer strong enough to justify an independent-seed RoBERTa run.
next_route: Do not replicate RoBERTa or revive explicit source-absent target weighting. Design a compact-data factor decomposition under ordinary WWM around content density, source-wide/tail coverage, lexical recurrence, faithful compression/surface naturalness, and reinvested diversity.
